IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access to an organization due to improper verification of a cryptographic signature. A token is accepted without its signature being fully verified, which could allow an attacker to join an organization without a valid invitation.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow arbitrary code to be executed by the management service in certain non-default configurations due to improper control of generation of code. Customization content may be evaluated as code, which is only possible where the related feature is enabled and not properly restricted.

The Affiliate Program Suite — SliceWP Affiliates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'email' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.14 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The injection is reachable without any account because the vulnerable code path is triggered via the user_register hook fired on every successful WooCommerce My Account registration, which requires only a guest-obtainable nonce.

The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.2 via the init_routes due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to read paid course lesson and topic content without enrollment, retrieve quiz answer keys including the is_correct field before attempting a quiz, and enumerate the email addresses, usernames, and registration data of other users including instructors and administrators. Exploitation requires that the attacker hold a valid Tutor LMS API key/secret pair, which is issued to subscriber-level users through the plugin's API key management feature.
vp: tutor lms – elearning and online course solution

cves.d: IBM Aspera Faspex 5.0.0 through 5.0.19 could allow an authorized user to craft a specific message to bypass user authorization and gain full administrative privileges.

A vulnerability was detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected is the function setWiFiMultipleConfig/delWiFiMultipleConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Multi-SSID Configuration. The manipulation of the argument wepkey2/wepkey3 results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

A security flaw has been discovered in InfiniFlow RAGFlow up to 0.27.2/1.0.0-rc2. This impacts the function RunSQL of the file internal/engine/infinity/sql.go of the component Text To SQL Retrieval. The manipulation of the argument tableName/kbIDs results in authorization bypass. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

ZaneOps 1.14.0 before 1.15.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows any workspace administrator to read another workspace's pending preview environment by querying ReviewPreviewEnvDeployAPIView without project scoping. Attackers can use the project slug and environment name from public fork pull request comments to retrieve plaintext environment variables and preview basic-auth credentials.

emailflare before commit cf31f33 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in POST /api/inbox/compose that allows authenticated members to send mail as any sender address. Attackers can supply an arbitrary from field, which is passed unchecked to the Cloudflare send call, to impersonate other users or the organization to external recipients.

A vulnerability was found in miroslavpejic85 MiroTalk P2P up to 2.0.87/2.1.38. Affected by this issue is the function CheckPassword of the file app/src/server.js of the component Socket IO Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument peer_id results in improper access controls. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.1.39 can resolve this issue. The patch is named 4e40471abc48bfc32b4b174b8844716dfc5c1471. You should upgrade the affected component.

Etrel INCH AC charging station management web interface prior to firmware versions 7.1.2 and 8.0.1 contains a hard-coded default credentials vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain full Administrator access by authenticating with the factory-default account. Attackers can log in over cleartext HTTP to obtain complete charger configuration, OCPP ChargePoint Identity, and CSMS WebSocket connection details, enabling unauthorized administrative control of the charging station.

A vulnerability was detected in IrfanView 4.76.0.0 on Win64. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the component TIFF Wang Annotation Handler. Performing a manipulation results in heap-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The complexity of an attack is rather high. The exploitation appears to be difficult. The exploit is now public and may be used. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue. The vendor confirms: "[T]he TIF-Annotations option is OFF by default. Means, normal users are not affected ... the danger level for this is low".

Angular is a development platform for building mobile and desktop web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and other languages. From 21.2.0 until 21.2.25 and 22.2.1, RouterLink directives rendered during Node.js server-side rendering retain computed UrlTree instances for the lifetime of each request. When queryParamsHandling is set to merge or preserve, either per link or through defaultQueryParamsHandling, every rendered link can retain a copy of attacker-controlled query parameters in its UrlTree. When upstream proxies or load balancers forward oversized query strings without rejecting them at the edge, multiple affected links and overlapping renders can amplify heap use until the Node.js old-space heap is exhausted and the SSR worker terminates. Numeric query-parameter names increase allocation pressure but are not required, memory is released after rendering completes, and pure client-side SPAs are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 21.2.25 and 22.2.1.

Dell Wyse Management Suite, versions prior to 2609.0.0.155, contain an Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Script injection.

Terragrunt is a flexible orchestration tool that allows Infrastructure as Code written in OpenTofu or Terraform to scale. Prior to 1.1.1, the terragrunt catalog command derives a predictable per-repository catalog clone root under the shared system temporary directory and follows a symlink already placed at that path. A local attacker who can write to the temporary directory and predict the cataloged repository can redirect cleanup and cloning outside the intended root, causing an existing repository-named directory to be deleted and replaced in the victim's security context. The attack requires the victim to run terragrunt catalog on a shared host while the symlink is present, and it is not remotely exploitable. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.1.

node-opcua is an OPC UA implementation for TypeScript and Node.js. From 2.42.0 until 2.180.0, namespace-level access control configured through setDefaultRolePermissions is not honored by the runtime enforcement path for nodes without explicit per-node RolePermissions. SessionContext.getApplicableRolePermissions reads a missing or null DefaultRolePermissions metadata value instead of the configured namespace field, and the null result is treated permissively. An anonymous network client can consequently write variables with CurrentWrite access or call bound methods when an operator configured a restrictive namespace default and relied on inheritance. Servers with no declared policy, nodes with explicit per-node permissions, and correctly bound programmatic namespace metadata are outside the authorization-bypass case. This issue is fixed in version 2.180.0.

MyTube is a self-hosted downloader and player for several video websites. Prior to 1.10.6, shouldSkipCsrfProtection() in backend/src/middleware/csrfConfig.ts delegates to isApiKeyRequest(), which grants a CSRF exemption based only on the presence of an x-api-key header or an Authorization: ApiKey value rather than successful API-key validation. With a permissive CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS configuration, an unauthenticated attacker can lure an authenticated administrator to attacker-controlled content that sends a cross-origin state-changing request with an arbitrary API-key value. The victim's session cookie authenticates the request while CSRF token validation is skipped, allowing destructive or other administrator API operations such as deleting media, triggering downloads, or changing subscriptions. This issue is fixed in version 1.10.6.

Vembu BDRSuite before 7.6.0 contains an unauthenticated cross-site scripting vulnerability in templates/progress/serverside/serverbackupprogress.sgp that allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary JavaScript by manipulating request parameters such as ClientName, BackupName, and grpName that are interpolated unsanitized into loadXMLDoc() calls and reflected in AbortBackup() POST requests to dodeleteclientbackup.sgp. Attackers can craft malicious links or requests to execute arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser session, enabling session hijacking or interface manipulation.

The Active Woot Products Tables for WooCommerce. 100% FREE plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Media Library File Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.5 This is due to the `get_table_data()` AJAX handler — registered for unauthenticated access via `wp_ajax_nopriv_woot_get_table_data` — performing no nonce verification and no capability check before passing the attacker-supplied `wp_columns_actions` parameter directly to `apply_filters()` alongside an attacker-controlled integer derived from the `table_id` parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete any WordPress media library attachment and its underlying file in the uploads directory by supplying a known or guessed numeric attachment ID, enabling complete erasure of a site's media library. Exploitation is achievable because WordPress core registers `wp_delete_attachment()` as a callback on hooks such as `upgrader_scheduled_cleanup` and `importer_scheduled_cleanup`, which `sanitize_key()` does not strip; notably, only attachment posts reachable by numeric ID are affected, and files outside `wp-content/uploads` — such as `wp-config.php` or plugin PHP files — cannot be targeted through this path.
vp: active woot products tables for woocommerce. 100% free

cves.d: The Printcart Store – Web to Print Product Designer for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 2.13.2. This is due to the `nbu_crop_image` AJAX handler accepting a user-supplied `url` parameter that `Nbdesigner_IO::convert_url_to_path()` concatenates onto the uploads base directory without normalizing or stripping `../` sequences, and then deriving both the output directory and output file extension via `pathinfo()` from the same attacker-controlled path — with no `stripImage()` call before `writeImage()` is invoked. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to write attacker-controlled PHP content to arbitrary locations outside the uploads directory, resulting in remote code execution when the written file is subsequently requested. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the `nbdesigner_upload_popup_style` site option is set to `a` (Advanced Upload Popup), which causes the handler to be registered for unauthenticated requests; however, the required `save-design` nonce is printed on the fully public frontend `upload-design-file` page, making it trivially obtainable by any anonymous visitor once that configuration is active.
vp: printcart store – web to print product designer for woocommerce

cves.d: isomorphic-git is a pure JavaScript implementation of Git for Node.js and browsers. Prior to 1.38.6, isomorphic-git reads a server-controlled targetSize while applying a packfile delta in src/utils/applyDelta.js and passes it without a bound to Buffer.alloc(targetSize). A malicious or man-in-the-middle-controlled remote can send one delta header that causes git.clone() or git.fetch() to allocate approximately 2 GB before validating the actual delta output. GitPackIndex.fromPack swallows the later size-mismatch error, so a host with sufficient memory may retain the resource waste without a visible failure, while containers, serverless functions, and small virtual machines may terminate. Node.js heap limits do not mitigate the off-heap Buffer allocation. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.6.

isomorphic-git is a pure JavaScript implementation of Git for Node.js and browsers. Prior to 1.38.6, isomorphic-git's tree parser in src/models/GitTree.js accepts a standalone .. tree-entry name because it rejects only path separators. During clone or checkout from a malicious or man-in-the-middle-controlled non-GitHub remote, nested .. entries can escape the working-tree root and write files at attacker-selected parent paths on any host-backed fs provider. The arbitrary file write can overwrite startup or configuration files and lead to code execution. GitHub-hosted trees are not a direct source because GitHub rejects .. entries during repository integrity checks. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.6.

fastapi-code-generator creates FastAPI applications from OpenAPI files. Prior to 0.8.1, the generator inserts an OpenAPI path into a generated @app.get(...) route decorator as a single-quoted generated route string without escaping embedded quotes. An attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced OpenAPI path can close the string and inject a valid Python expression into the decorator argument. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the application's or CI process's privileges when the generated module is imported and the decorator is evaluated. This OpenAPI path sink is distinct from the project's separate operation-summary docstring and additional-response-key sinks. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.1.

A vulnerability was determined in mathurvishal CloudClassroom-PHP-Project. The affected element is the function session_regenerate_id of the file loginlinkadmin.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument PHPSESSID can lead to session fixiation. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. This product does not use versioning. This is why information about affected and unaffected releases are unavailable. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

GeoNetwork is a catalog application to manage spatially referenced resources. From 4.0.0-alpha.1 until 4.2.16 and 4.4.11, the Elasticsearch-backed search proxy can skip GeoNetwork's access-control filter injection when a client request has an omitted query field. The request is then forwarded to Elasticsearch without group visibility, draft exclusion, record ownership, or portal-specific filtering. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use the affected public search API to retrieve the full indexed contents of metadata records that should not be publicly visible. This issue is fixed in versions 4.2.16 and 4.4.11.

OPNsense is a FreeBSD based firewall and routing platform. Prior to 26.1.11 and 26.4.1p1, authenticated Web UI or API users with delegated access to affected settings can submit CR or LF characters in fields expected to contain one line, causing generated privileged service configuration files to contain additional attacker-controlled directives or policy lines. The confirmed Dnsmasq path includes dhcp_boot.filename, dhcp_boot.servername, dhcp_boot.address, and dhcp_options.value, which are rendered into /usr/local/etc/dnsmasq.conf; access through page-services-dnsforwarder covers api/dnsmasq/*. Related affected fields span OpenVPN, DHCPv6, Unbound, IPsec, NTP, PPP or MPD, Monit, firewall, sudo, WebGUI, and System General configuration. Applying or restarting the affected service can alter behavior beyond the delegated setting, create service-side files, cross RBAC boundaries, or cause denial of service. Line injection through Monit mail password and adjacent Monit text fields into /usr/local/etc/monitrc demonstrated root command execution. Arbitrary shell command execution was not confirmed for the Dnsmasq path. This issue is fixed in versions 26.1.11 and 26.4.1p1.

Elo is a purely functional expression language for no-code tools. Prior to 1.0.1, plain Elo strings supplied to defaultFormats.elo.parse(), bin/elo, or elo-lang.org/try can use .constructor.constructor to reach JavaScript Function because the member_access handler in src/transform.ts does not reject meta-properties, src/compilers/javascript.ts emits the surviving property directly, and src/parser.ts accepts constructor as an ordinary identifier. The resulting generated JavaScript executes attacker-selected code in the host runtime. This permits browser script execution and session compromise on the auto-running playground and arbitrary Node.js code execution on library, CI, or DevOps hosts. This plain-string path is distinct from the programmatic AST-object injection issue. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.1.

GNU Gatekeeper (gnugk) before 5.16 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in H46024Socket::ReceivedProbePacket() that allows remote attackers to cause a heap over-read by sending short probe packets. Attackers can send a short application-defined RTCP packet to the media port during H.460.24 probing to read past the heap allocation and possibly crash the gatekeeper.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WC Lovers WCFM Membership wc-multivendor-membership allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WCFM Membership: from n/a through 2.12.0.

Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in WPVibes AnyWhere Elementor anywhere-elementor allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects AnyWhere Elementor: from n/a through 1.3.0.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Uncanny Owl Uncanny Automator uncanny-automator allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Uncanny Automator: from n/a through 7.7.1.

A vulnerability has been found in phpMyAdmin ShapeFile up to 4.0.1. Impacted is the function ShapeRecord::loadFromFile of the component SHP File Handler. Such manipulation leads to infinite loop. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw was found in the GStreamer JPEG 2000 decimator in gst-plugins-bad. Crafted JPEG 2000 media can cause integer overflows or division by zero during tile processing. An application that processes the malicious media may crash, resulting in a denial of service.

wlroots before 0.20.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_surface_class() in xwayland/xwm.c that allows local X11 clients to leak compositor heap memory. Attackers can set a WM_CLASS property with a NUL-terminated instance but unterminated class, exposing over-read heap bytes as the window class or app_id over IPC.

Coolify before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate application names across all teams via manual GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Gitea webhooks. Attackers can send a repository name of % or empty with a common branch like main, exploiting unescaped LIKE wildcards to receive every matching application name before signature verification.

Label Studio before 1.23.2 (label-studio-sdk before 2.1.2) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read internal URLs through image-bearing export formats. Attackers can import tasks with data.image pointing at internal services, export as YOLO or COCO with images to read responses, and spoof Host to capture the organization owner's API token.

WPPConnect Server through 2.10.74 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to send WhatsApp messages by calling the Chatwoot webhook route without verifyToken middleware. Attackers who know or guess a connected session name can POST outgoing message bodies to send arbitrary texts or files from that account to any number.

Cotonti through 1.0.0 generates registration and email-change validation tokens with md5(microtime()), allowing attackers to bypass email-ownership verification by predicting tokens. Attackers can derive the generation time from the HTTP Date header and compute candidate tokens offline. They then submit these tokens to the users.register.php validate handler to activate accounts or confirm email addresses they do not control.

nnn through 5.3 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability in the pdfread and nuke plugins that allows local attackers to overwrite files by exploiting predictable paths in /tmp. Attackers can pre-create a symlink at the name-derived or PID-derived path so the victim's plugin truncates and overwrites any file the victim can write.

Dreeve before 5.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in StravaWebhookRequestHandler::handleEvent that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge Strava webhook events without signature, verify-token or owner_id checks. Attackers can send forged delete events with a known public Strava activity id to the webhook URL, causing permanent deletion of imported activities and their streams.

Padloc through 4.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in ScimServer._handleScimGet() that allows unauthenticated attackers to read SCIM directories by sending any non-empty bearer token. Attackers who know an organization id can query the Users and Groups SCIM endpoints to retrieve provisioned usernames, emails, names, externalIds, and group memberships.

CFNext before 3.1.0 contains a weak cryptographic derivation vulnerability that allows subscription link holders to recover the admin password because the subscription UUID is an MD5 of the password with a fixed public salt. Attackers can brute-force the password offline without rate limiting, log into the admin panel, and read stored Trojan, Clash, Telegram and Cloudflare API secrets.

svg-sanitizer from 0.5.0 before 1.1.0 contains an incomplete filtering vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass remote URL removal by using CSS escape sequences inside url() in SVG presentation attributes. Attackers can supply SVG files with attributes like fill containing escaped slashes that browsers resolve to remote URLs, triggering external requests and enabling data exfiltration.

Frappe HRMS before 15.61.0 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to view other employees' expense advance details due to improper authorization checks. Attackers can query the Expense Claim Advances API to retrieve expense advance records belonging to other employees, exposing sensitive financial information.

Mistune before 3.3.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability in InlineParser.parse_link that allows attackers to cause quadratic CPU growth by supplying balanced nested brackets. Attackers can submit crafted Markdown with thousands of nested bracket pairs not forming a valid link, triggering repeated _contains_nested_link scans that exhaust CPU in parsing applications.

Froxlor 2.3.0 before 2.3.15 contains a missing authorization check in the Certificates.add and Certificates.update API commands, which do not verify whether a domain's certificate is Let's Encrypt-managed. Customers with API access can overwrite the managed certificate and private key with an attacker-chosen pair, which a REBUILD_VHOST task deploys to the webserver, breaking HTTPS and desynchronizing ACME automation.

AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET and POST /api/station/{station_id}/waveform/{media_id} routes, which lack Permissions middleware. Any authenticated user without station assignment can read another station's cached waveform JSON and overwrite it with attacker-supplied data, corrupting Visual Cue Editor data.

Nodemailer from 3.0.0 before 10.1.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that ends an angle-addr at a '>' inside a quoted local part, comment or domain literal. Attackers can submit addresses that validate as an allowed domain but are delivered to an attacker-controlled domain, bypassing recipient allow lists and disclosing message content.

SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows database Owners to bypass port-specific deny-net rules by using JWKS URLs with implicit default ports. Attackers can configure a JWT or record access method whose JWKS URL omits port 80 or 443, causing blind GET requests to explicitly denied internal services.

SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows record users to infer restricted field values because the streaming planner uses indexes on fields with restrictive SELECT permissions. Attackers can issue full-text MATCHES, compound B-tree, or HNSW KNN queries against restricted fields to learn which records contain guessed values or nearest vectors.

Parse Server before 8.6.110 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.6-alpha.2 fails to contain a serialization error when an object update uses a dot notation key targeting a pointer field's object identifier on a class with an afterSave trigger. Attackers, including unauthenticated clients when objects are writable without a session, can send such an update to crash the Node process.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the RDPGFX ALPHA WIRETOSURFACE_2 handler that fails to validate zero surface dimensions. A malicious RDP server can send a crafted WIRETOSURFACE_2 PDU with zero width and height, triggering an assertion or division by zero that terminates the client session.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 allows a client assertion abort because rdpgfx_on_data_received rejects only negative zgfx_decompress status and passes the resulting null output pointer to Stream_StaticConstInit. A malicious RDP server can send a zero-output ZGFX payload on the RDPGFX channel after session activation to terminate the client.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows malicious RDP servers to crash xfreerdp clients by sending a zero-width RDPGFX ResetGraphics PDU. The failed resize in gdi_resize_ex leaves the primary display null without ending the session, so a later bitmap update crashes the client in gdi_Bitmap_Paint.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a cross-thread use-after-free vulnerability in the freerdp-proxy dyn-channel-dump module during session teardown. A malicious RDP target can send dynamic channel data while the front client disconnects, letting the client thread read freed ChannelData and crash the proxy process.

FreeRDP from 3.11.0 before 3.32.2 contains an assertion failure in the RemoteFX RLGR decoder that allows malicious servers to terminate clients. Attackers controlling an RDP server can send a RemoteFX tileset with RLGR code 32767, triggering a signed narrowing assertion in rfx_rlgr_decode and crashing the client.

FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.2 built with WITH_AAD=ON contains a reachable assertion because its ARM gateway response parser accepts a missing or non-string redirectedServerCert field and passes a null buffer to the certificate parser. A malicious or malformed user-selected gateway can return such a response to abort the client process.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in WinPR's winpr_read_png_from_buffer() and winpr_convert_from_jpeg(), which lack libpng/libjpeg error handling. A malicious RDP server or MITM can offer a malformed PNG or truncated JPEG clipboard payload, causing the client to abort or exit.

The BuddyBoss App plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.1 via the send_feedback function. This is due to insufficient file type validation that relies solely on the client-supplied Content-Type header without server-side content inspection or extension validation. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. While uploaded files are deleted after email transmission, a race condition exists during SMTP execution that allows access to the file, and files persist indefinitely when wp_mail() fails.
Insufficient bounds checking in the Digital I/O function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to cause a denial of service.
Improper input validation in management control functions may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject operating system commands and execute them with root privileges.

The WooCommerce Multilingual & Multicurrency with WPML plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection in all versions up to, and including, 5.5.7. This is due to insufficient input validation on the currency exchange rate parameter in the save_currency() AJAX handler, which lacks capability checks and allows subscriber-level users to store malicious SQL payloads that are later concatenated directly into ORDER BY clauses without proper sanitization. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Shop Manager-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries to extract sensitive information from the database.

The WP Compress – Instant Performance & Speed Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 7.22.01. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to link the victim site to an attacker-controlled WP Compress account, overwrite plugin settings to an aggressive live-CDN preset, and gain the shared api_key that authenticates all nopriv HMAC-gated endpoints — enabling full control over cache purging, file deletion, opcode cache invalidation, and other privileged plugin operations. This vulnerability only affects fresh installations or lite/free-mode installs where no api_key is already stored, as the sole guard fails open when the stored key is absent.
vp: wp compress – instant performance & speed optimization

cves.d: The BuddyPress XProfile Image Field plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.0. This is due to bpxp_image_field_update_on_user_activation() calling unlink() on a path built from visitor-supplied signup metadata with no realpath() resolution, no containment check against the profile-image directory and no extension allow-list. Submitting a zero-byte file with the 'field_N_hidden' parameter during registration makes the plugin store the raw value, which is then resolved against the document root when the pending signup is activated. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file (such as wp-config.php) is deleted. Requires open registration and an image-type profile field on the signup form.

The Fluent Support – Helpdesk & Customer Support Ticket System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated modification of a linked customer's stored profile fields in versions up to, and including, 2.4.7 Its first-party Fluent Forms integration (FeedIntegration::notify()) opens a ticket from each public form submission and, for a logged-out submitter, resolves the submitted email to an existing WordPress account via get_user_by('email', ...) without verifying the submitter controls that address, then passes the attacker-supplied data to Customer::maybeCreateCustomer(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to overwrite a limited set of a registered customer's stored profile fields where an administrator has enabled a FluentSupport feed on a public form. The email address, role and status are never changed; first and last name are overwritten only when the target user has no name set in user meta; and other fields (title, address, city, state, zip, country) are writable only where an administrator has mapped them in the feed.
vp: fluent support – helpdesk & customer support ticket system

cves.d: The Jupiter X Core plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 4.62.0 via the 'file' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. The path confinement check introduced in the CVE-2023-3813 fix (strpos + realpath) is present and working, so reads are confined to wp-content/uploads/ and cannot reach wp-config.php or other files outside that directory.

The Noptin – Newsletter, New Post Notifications & Email Automation plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.3 via the 'noptin_fields[first_name]' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The public Manage Preferences page issues a nonce to unauthenticated visitors, meaning there is no effective authorization barrier — an unauthenticated attacker can store the malicious payload as their first_name and have it executed the next time any newsletter is sent by the site operator. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
vp: noptin – newsletter, new post notifications & email automation

cves.d: hustoj >=24.09.10 and <=26.08.19 is vulnerable to Incorrect Access Control. Any registered user can delete, lock, or sticky any forum thread (including admins' announcements) via threadadmin.php. The thread branch only verifies login, never authorship or admin rights.

The Jupiter X Core plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.62.0 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to enumerate and render arbitrary published post types not intended for public listing — including Flamingo CF7 submission records containing submitter names, email addresses, phone numbers, full messages, and IP addresses — and perform meta_query boolean-oracle reads against the postmeta of any published post. Exploitation requires that a Posts or Advanced Posts widget on the site has 'Is Archive Template' enabled, which is the standard Jupiter X archive-template configuration used by most Jupiter X sites; additionally, the nonce verified by the second endpoint is minted via wp_create_nonce and printed on every frontend page as ravenTools.nonce, rendering it ineffective as an authorization barrier.

The Greenshift – animation and page builder blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 13.2.2 via the 'img (or any key the publisher references in {{GET:key}})' parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract authenticated users' HttpOnly WordPress session cookies, specifically wordpress_logged_in_* tokens, by injecting a nested {{COOKIE:}} placeholder via a GET parameter that causes the victim's browser to transmit the cookie value to an attacker-controlled host as an image src URL. Exploitation requires that a site publisher has configured a public GreenShift Element image block whose src attribute contains a {{GET:}} placeholder, and that a logged-in user can be induced to open the attacker's crafted link — neither condition is part of the plugin's default state.
vp: greenshift – animation and page builder blocks

cves.d: The payever – WooCommerce Gateway plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file upload leading to remote code execution in various versions up to, and including, 4.8.0. Three WooCommerce-API callbacks (payever_set_sandbox_api_keys, payever_toggle_subscription, payever_synchronization_incoming) are registered with no authentication, capability check, or nonce, and the upload_image() routine writes a remotely fetched file to the public uploads directory using an attacker-controlled basename() BEFORE validating the file type. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to write an executable PHP file and achieve remote code execution. NOTE: the token-recovery leg of the full chain depends on the plugin's outbound validateToken() call to Payever's service; the unauthenticated hard-coded-credential identity overwrite (CWE-862/CWE-798) is independently exploitable.

PyMuPDF 1.25.3 before 2.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in JM_set_annot_callout_line() that copies a caller-supplied number of callout points into a fixed three-element stack array. Attackers who control the callout argument passed to Page.add_freetext_annot() can supply four or more points to overwrite the stack frame, crashing the process or executing code.

A flaw was found in hivex. By supplying a specially crafted Windows registry hive file, an attacker can trigger an out-of-bounds memory read when hivex parses registry values containing malformed large data block lists. This issue can cause the application processing the registry file to crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

The VobSub subtitle decoder libsub_vob (part of the Amlogic DroidLogic SubTitleService), as shipped on Nexbox A95X (Amlogic S905X) TV boxes, contains an infinite loop vulnerability in get_vob_spu() that allows unauthenticated network attackers or local users loading malicious files to trigger an unreachable loop exit condition via mismatched length fields. Attackers can send crafted AMLU data blocks over the unauthenticated tcp/10100 listener or via a malicious VobSub (.sub) file to cause the subtitle decode thread to spin at 100% CPU indefinitely, resulting in denial of service.

Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-06-17 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to access another user's purchase inquiry by manipulating the thread identifier in the GET /purchase-inquiry/thread/{thread-id} endpoint. Attackers can modify the thread ID to read supplier communication and quotation-related content belonging to other users, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive business information outside their access scope.

A security vulnerability has been detected in AndyFactory newspaper4k up to 0.9.6. This affects the function Article.parse of the file newspaper/extractors/image_extractor.py of the component Image Extractor. Such manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 0.9.6.1 mitigates this issue. The name of the patch is eec5fab21897c14667c98f5ba1831ebd3a692dd4. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

An Otter Wiki 2.20.1 before 2.26.2 contains a file disclosure vulnerability in the DataTable embedding that allows attackers who can edit pages, including anonymous users under the default configuration, to read repository-internal files. Attackers can set an absolute src such as /.git/config to render the file as a table, exposing any stored remote credentials.

Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.29 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the loopback API /valid_token/ route that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root by injecting shell metacharacters into the unvalidated 'user' parameter. Attackers can send a crafted request to the /valid_token/ route, which passes the parameter unescaped into a shell_exec() call.

Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.16 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the loopback API authentication gate access_token(), which connects to MySQL as root and interpolates attacker-controlled values directly into its query. Attackers can inject SQL through the authorization_code and client_id parameters to read arbitrary database contents and forge the authentication result, bypassing the API's authentication check.

Chainlit 2.12.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass path-scoped MCP allowed_urls entries because validate_mcp_url does not reject the semicolon character. Attackers can submit MCP URLs with '..;' segments to the /mcp endpoint, causing requests to paths outside the operator's grant on origins that strip semicolon path parameters.

ai.summary_en: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a significant surge in remotely exploitable flaws across web applications, cloud infrastructure, and network equipment, with authentication bypasses and arbitrary code execution dominating the threat landscape. Critical weaknesses were identified in widely used platforms including WordPress and WooCommerce plugins, AWS Babelfish, Red Hat Keycloak, IBM API Connect, and Cisco networking gear, alongside numerous buffer overflow vulnerabilities in consumer and enterprise routers. These findings underscore persistent risks in third-party integrations, misconfigured access controls, and insufficient input validation that continue to enable unauthorized system access and data compromise across both IT and operational environments.
ai.summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞显示，Web 应用、云基础设施和网络设备中可远程利用的缺陷显著激增，其中身份验证绕过与任意代码执行主导了当前威胁态势。在广泛使用的平台中发现了多项关键弱点，包括 WordPress 与 WooCommerce 插件、AWS Babelfish、Red Hat Keycloak、IBM API Connect 及 Cisco 网络设备，同时消费级与企业级路由器中也存在大量缓冲区溢出漏洞。上述发现凸显了第三方集成、访问控制配置不当及输入验证不足所带来的持续风险，这些缺陷继续在 IT 与运营环境中导致未授权系统访问与数据受损。

items.reason_en: Allows local code execution via an out-of-bounds read in Windows Paint, a pre-installed utility frequently targeted by social engineering and malware droppers.
items.reason_zh: 允许通过 Windows Paint 中的越界读取漏洞实现本地代码执行。该预装工具常被社会工程攻击和恶意软件释放程序利用。

items.reason_en: A kernel-level use-after-free in the NVMe/TCP subsystem can trigger remote code execution or information leakage, severely impacting host stability and security.
items.reason_zh: NVMe/TCP 子系统内核级释放后使用漏洞可触发远程代码执行或信息泄露，严重影响主机稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild; malicious GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variables enable local privilege escalation via SUID binaries.
items.reason_zh: 已在实际环境中被积极利用；恶意的 GLIBC_TUNABLES 环境变量可通过 SUID 程序实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Lack of validation in eBPF dynamic pointers allows CAP_BPF users to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: eBPF 动态指针未经验证，致使具备 CAP_BPF 权限的用户可提升权限并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: JSON compilation database parsing flaw in CLion enables arbitrary code execution even in restricted safe mode.
items.reason_zh: CLion 的 JSON 编译数据库解析缺陷即使在受限安全模式下也可导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-range modifier values in X.Org requests cause heap overflow, allowing authenticated clients to crash or execute code.
items.reason_zh: X.Org 请求中的越界修饰符值会引发堆溢出，使经过身份验证的客户端可导致系统崩溃或执行代码。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in libX11's XCreateImage function permits local execution of arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
items.reason_zh: libX11 的 XCreateImage 函数存在整数溢出漏洞，攻击者可借此在本地以高权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Causes denial of service in FreeRDP clients when processing malformed clipboard images, disrupting remote desktop connectivity and endpoint availability.
items.reason_zh: 在处理格式异常的剪贴板图像时会导致 FreeRDP 客户端发生拒绝服务，中断远程桌面连接并影响终端可用性。

items.reason_en: Enables script injection via cross-site scripting in Dell Wyse Management Suite, potentially compromising thin client administration interfaces and corporate endpoint fleets.
items.reason_zh: Dell Wyse Management Suite 中存在跨站脚本漏洞，可导致脚本注入，进而威胁瘦客户端管理界面及企业终端设备群的安全。

items.reason_en: A critical heap-based buffer overflow in the Tenda AC19 router firmware enables remote code execution, with publicly released exploits actively targeting consumer networks.
items.reason_zh: Tenda AC19 路由器固件中存在严重的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。目前已有公开利用代码正被积极用于攻击消费级网络。

items.reason_en: Remote buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK CA300-PoE web management interface allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands, exacerbated by the availability of public proof-of-concept code.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE Web 管理界面存在远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可借此执行任意命令。现有公开的概念验证代码进一步加剧了该风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the OpenBMB Agent Registry allows unauthorized actors to manipulate agent configurations.
items.reason_zh: OpenBMB Agent Registry 缺乏身份验证机制，致使未授权实体可篡改代理配置。

items.reason_en: Improper access controls in the message handler expose chat records to unauthorized users within the IoT agent framework.
items.reason_zh: 消息处理程序中的访问控制缺陷导致物联网代理框架内的聊天记录向未授权用户泄露。

items.reason_en: Exposes EV charging stations to unauthorized full administrator access via hardcoded default credentials transmitted over clear-text connections, enabling physical and operational sabotage.
items.reason_zh: 通过明文通道传输的硬编码默认凭据使电动汽车充电桩暴露于未授权的全局管理员访问之下，可能导致物理设施与运营遭到破坏。

items.reason_en: Allows privileged remote attackers to inject and execute operating system commands through improperly validated management control inputs, compromising embedded device functionality.
items.reason_zh: 允许具有特权的远程攻击者通过未经验证的管理控制输入注入并执行操作系统命令，从而破坏嵌入式设备的正常运行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in AWS Babelfish for PostgreSQL enables remote command execution as the database process user, directly threatening cloud-hosted data integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: AWS Babelfish for PostgreSQL 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可借助数据库进程用户权限远程执行命令，直接威胁云端数据完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: SAML signature verification flaw in Red Hat Keycloak allows authentication bypass via percent-encoded parameter manipulation, compromising enterprise identity federation workflows.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Keycloak 的 SAML 签名验证存在缺陷，攻击者可通过操纵百分号编码的参数绕过身份验证，进而破坏企业身份联邦工作流。

items.reason_en: Client management flaw in Keycloak fails to clear session attributes, enabling authenticated privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak 客户端管理模块存在缺陷，未能正确清理会话属性，致使已认证用户可实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Regular expression denial of service and wildcard query bypass in IBM API Connect severely impact gateway availability and security.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 存在正则表达式拒绝服务漏洞及通配符查询绕过缺陷，严重削弱网关的可用性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper neutralization of special elements in IBM API Connect allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 未正确过滤特殊字符，致使远程攻击者可执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized user input passed to the OS shell in IBM API Connect enables remote code execution on the management server.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 将未经验证的用户输入直接传入操作系统 Shell，致使管理服务器可被远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: LDAP injection in directory queries modifies query logic, granting unauthorized administrative access to other tenants.
items.reason_zh: 目录查询中的 LDAP 注入漏洞会篡改查询逻辑，致使攻击者可获取其他租户的未授权管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded credentials in IBM API Connect allow remote attackers to gain full administrative control over the platform.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 存在硬编码凭据漏洞，远程攻击者可借此获取平台的完整管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Authentication flow flaw in JetBrains Hub allows account takeover by modifying email details during verification.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains Hub 的身份验证流程存在缺陷，攻击者可通过在验证阶段篡改邮箱信息劫持用户账户。

items.reason_en: Grants full administrative privileges to authorized users by bypassing authorization checks in IBM Aspera Faspex, risking complete cloud storage and data synchronization compromise.
items.reason_zh: IBM Aspera Faspex 因绕过授权检查而向合法用户授予完整管理员权限，导致云存储与数据同步面临全面失陷风险。

items.reason_en: Provides unauthenticated root-level OS command injection via an unvalidated parameter in Control Web Panel, severely impacting hosted web infrastructure and tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Control Web Panel 存在未经验证的参数，可导致未授权身份下执行 Root 级操作系统命令注入，严重威胁托管 Web 基础设施及租户隔离性。

items.reason_en: High-severity vulnerability in Cisco NX-OS impacts core switching infrastructure, with a notably elevated EPSS score indicating significant likelihood of real-world exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Cisco NX-OS 存在高危漏洞，直接影响核心交换基础设施。其 EPSS 评分显著偏高，表明在实际环境中被利用的概率极大。

items.reason_en: Critical flaw in Cisco License On-Prem (formerly SSM On-Prem) could allow remote attackers to compromise network licensing services, disrupting device provisioning and compliance tracking.
items.reason_zh: Cisco License On-Prem（原 SSM On-Prem）存在严重缺陷，远程攻击者可借此破坏网络授权服务，导致设备部署与合规追踪中断。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Samba's RPC service allows unauthorized access to sensitive files and potential system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Samba RPC 服务存在路径穿越漏洞，致使未授权方可访问敏感文件，甚至导致系统失陷。

items.reason_en: Remote buffer overflow in TOTOLINK router CGI interface enables remote code execution on widely deployed network hardware.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK 路由器 CGI 接口存在远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可借此在大量部署的网络设备上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: LAN configuration buffer overflow in router firmware facilitates remote exploitation and complete device takeover.
items.reason_zh: 路由器固件中的LAN配置缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程利用并完全接管设备。

items.reason_en: Malformed SIP MESSAGE parsing in FreeSWITCH can crash telecom infrastructure or enable downstream attacks.
items.reason_zh: FreeSWITCH中畸形SIP MESSAGE消息的解析缺陷可能导致电信基础设施崩溃或引发下游攻击。

items.reason_en: Triggers a stack-based buffer overflow in TOTOLINK router firmware via manipulated Wi-Fi configuration arguments, potentially leading to remote code execution on edge network hardware.
items.reason_zh: 通过篡改Wi-Fi配置参数在TOTOLINK路由器固件中触发基于栈的缓冲区溢出，可能导致边缘网络设备上的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Allows authenticated users to inject line breaks into firewall configuration files via the OPNsense Web UI, disrupting network security policies and routing rules.
items.reason_zh: 允许已认证用户通过OPNsense Web UI向防火墙配置文件注入换行符，从而破坏网络安全策略和路由规则。

items.reason_en: Bypasses namespace-level access controls in node-opcua implementations, enabling unauthorized read/write operations on critical industrial protocol nodes and threatening OT environments.
items.reason_zh: 绕过node-opcua实现中的命名空间级访问控制，使攻击者能够对关键工业协议节点进行未授权读写操作，威胁OT环境安全。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in a widely deployed WooCommerce plugin allows unauthenticated actors to reset user passwords, directly facilitating account takeover and e-commerce fraud.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的WooCommerce插件存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证攻击者重置用户密码，直接导致账户接管和电子商务欺诈。

items.reason_en: Missing allow-list validation in the Registration Form for WooCommerce plugin enables privilege escalation, allowing attackers to elevate their access and potentially gain administrative control.
items.reason_zh: “Registration Form for WooCommerce”插件缺少允许列表验证，可导致权限提升，使攻击者提高访问权限并可能获取管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in the Radius Booking plugin permits object injection, which can be chained to achieve remote code execution on vulnerable WordPress environments.
items.reason_zh: “Radius Booking”插件中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，允许对象注入，该漏洞可被链式利用以在易受攻击的WordPress环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the LatePoint WordPress plugin enables direct account takeover via flawed query construction.
items.reason_zh: “LatePoint” WordPress插件存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可通过有缺陷的查询构造直接实现账户接管。

items.reason_en: PHP file inclusion vulnerability in DirectoryPress allows attackers to inject and execute arbitrary server-side code.
items.reason_zh: DirectoryPress插件中的PHP文件包含漏洞允许攻击者注入并执行任意服务器端代码。

items.reason_en: Untrusted deserialization in the Advanced Form Integration plugin enables remote code execution via PHP object injection.
items.reason_zh: “Advanced Form Integration”插件中的不受信任的反序列化漏洞可通过PHP对象注入实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted PHP deserialization in the QA Assistants plugin bypasses class restrictions, facilitating remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: “QA Assistants”插件中存在无限制的PHP反序列化漏洞，可绕过类限制，从而导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Chunked response handling flaw in Undertow leads to uncontrolled resource consumption and potential denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Undertow中分块响应处理缺陷会导致资源消耗失控及潜在的服务拒绝（DoS）风险。

items.reason_en: Remote authenticated attacker can execute arbitrary code due to improper control of code generation, posing a severe system compromise risk.
items.reason_zh: 由于对代码生成控制不当，远程认证攻击者可执行任意代码，构成严重的系统沦陷风险。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded credentials allow remote attackers to gain full administrative control, completely undermining platform security.
items.reason_zh: 硬编码凭据使远程攻击者能够获取完全的管理员控制权，彻底破坏平台安全性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal enables arbitrary file writes, potentially leading to complete server takeover or backdoor installation.
items.reason_zh: 路径遍历漏洞可导致任意文件写入，可能引发服务器完全接管或后门植入。

items.reason_en: SQL injection allows execution of arbitrary database commands, risking massive data exfiltration or manipulation.
items.reason_zh: SQL注入漏洞允许执行任意数据库命令，可能导致大规模数据泄露或被篡改。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via alternate paths grants unauthorized control over gateway configuration, disrupting API services.
items.reason_zh: 通过备用路径的身份验证绕过漏洞使攻击者能够未授权控制网关配置，从而破坏API服务。

items.reason_en: Insufficient input validation permits cross-tenant code execution and data access, breaking multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: 输入验证不足允许跨租户代码执行和数据访问，破坏了多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: XML external entity (XXE) injection exposes sensitive internal data and enables server-side request forgery.
items.reason_zh: XML外部实体（XXE）注入漏洞会暴露敏感的内部数据，并支持服务端请求伪造（SSRF）。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication enforcement against directory services allows attackers to steal valid access tokens for other users.
items.reason_zh: 针对目录服务的身份验证执行不当，使攻击者能够窃取其他用户的合法访问令牌。

items.reason_en: Allows authenticated attackers to bypass security token restrictions and modify sensitive data in IBM API Connect, undermining API governance and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: 允许已认证攻击者绕过IBM API Connect中的安全令牌限制并修改敏感数据，破坏API治理与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Enables remote code execution via arbitrary file upload in a widely deployed WooCommerce payment gateway plugin, directly compromising e-commerce infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的WooCommerce支付网关插件存在任意文件上传漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接危及电子商务基础设施。

items.reason_en: Permits arbitrary file uploads through insufficient type validation in a WordPress design plugin, allowing attackers to deploy malicious scripts on targeted sites.
items.reason_zh: WordPress设计插件因类型验证不足允许任意文件上传，使攻击者能够在目标站点部署恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Exposes Angular applications to potential session hijacking or state manipulation due to improper URL tree retention during server-side rendering.
items.reason_zh: 服务端渲染期间URL树保留不当，导致Angular应用面临会话劫持或状态篡改风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Babelfish TDS RPC parser exposes adjacent process memory, potentially leaking sensitive database credentials, query plans, or internal state.
items.reason_zh: Babelfish TDS RPC解析器中的越界读取漏洞会暴露相邻进程内存，可能导致敏感数据库凭据、查询计划或内部状态泄露。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in DataEase's chart data handler allows attackers to manipulate backend queries, risking unauthorized data extraction or destructive modifications to analytics datasets.
items.reason_zh: DataEase图表数据处理程序中的SQL注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵后端查询，可能导致未授权的数据提取或对分析数据集造成破坏性修改。

items.reason_en: OpenVAS port scanning against MariaDB triggers a remote denial of service, disrupting critical database availability.
items.reason_zh: 使用OpenVAS对MariaDB进行端口扫描会触发远程拒绝服务漏洞，破坏关键数据库的可用性。

items.reason_en: Failure to discard buffered plaintext bytes after StartTLS negotiation allows on-path attackers to inject and process LDAP messages.
items.reason_zh: StartTLS协商后未丢弃缓冲的明文字节，使中间人攻击者能够注入并处理LDAP消息。

items.reason_en: Circumvents access-control filters in GeoNetwork’s Elasticsearch proxy, exposing spatial data resources and metadata to unauthorized queries and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: 绕过GeoNetwork的Elasticsearch代理中的访问控制过滤器，使空间数据资源和元数据暴露于未授权查询和数据泄露风险中。

items.reason_en: Code execution via Grunt/Gulp task loading in JetBrains WebStorm compromises developer workstations and introduces supply chain risks through untrusted project configurations.
items.reason_zh: 通过 JetBrains WebStorm 中的 Grunt/Gulp 任务加载实现代码执行，会危及开发者工作站，并通过不受信任的项目配置引入供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Session forgery vulnerability in JetBrains Ktor allows tampering with encrypted session cookies, undermining application-level authentication and enabling unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains Ktor 中的会话伪造漏洞允许篡改加密的会话 Cookie，破坏应用层认证并导致未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in GCC's libstdc++ priority queue implementation can lead to memory corruption during application compilation.
items.reason_zh: GCC 的 libstdc++ 优先队列实现中存在释放后使用漏洞，可能导致在应用程序编译期间发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Allows JavaScript function execution via prototype pollution in the Elo expression language parser, affecting no-code tool integrations and backend logic evaluation.
items.reason_zh: 在 Elo 表达式语言解析器中可通过原型链污染执行 JavaScript 函数，影响无代码工具集成及后端逻辑评估。

items.reason_en: Introduces code injection risks in FastAPI applications generated from attacker-controlled OpenAPI specifications due to unescaped route strings in generated decorators.
items.reason_zh: 由于生成的装饰器中包含未转义的路由字符串，基于攻击者控制的 OpenAPI 规范生成的 FastAPI 应用程序会引入代码注入风险。
